owner_message_original: Рекомендую сначала подготовить отдельный GASPALS на 5.8 для твоей пробы сделай эту, вне мультики
owner_message_english_translation: Prepare the recommended separate GASPALS on 5.8 for my trial; do this outside Multica.
decision: Prepare a separate local GASPALS project for the owner's trial using the installed Unreal Engine 5.8, directly outside Multica.
execution: The controller performs the preparation directly. Bounded read-only source research and an independent technical review may use native subagents. Do not create or dispatch a Multica task for this work.
acceptance: Preserve upstream provenance; verify the prepared project opens in the installed UE 5.8, its demonstration level loads, and a focused Play smoke check works. Provide its local path and launch instructions. Owner movement and visual judgement remain separate.
preservation: Keep the GASPALS trial separate from MeridianSquad and the existing GameAnimationSample. Preserve existing owner edits, source assets and evidence. Do not integrate this trial into the active game.
constraints: Existing subscription and local tools only, no purchases or separately billed services; retain the standing storage, focused verification and closure commit rules.
